The optional browser component installer is the official Microsoft Edge WebView2
Evergreen Bootstrapper. It downloads and installs the shared WebView2 Runtime
only after the user chooses to install the web component.

Microsoft WebView2 Runtime and SDK license notices are included alongside this
file. No browser runtime is required for offline dictionary and mnemonic use.

Deployment documentation:
https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/concepts/distribution
